interpretation: Finite cases, not general planar-graph coverage. Limit remains inconclusive. Structured projections compare every available saved scope against all global solutions; explicit projection limits and truncated traces reduce that coverage. Random SAT cases preserve one independently supplied source witness only; random UNSAT statuses use frozen exhaustive-search references. Cycle supports are exact for each selected original cycle under its current literal domains. Discovery selects fundamental cycles of the original graph and domain-induced subgraphs; a completed prescribed scan never means all original cycles were enumerated. Caps may omit further optional propagators. Intersections and cycles repeat within reduction before exact elimination and final writeback. No uniqueness requirement and no timing criterion.
